versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the patent-panorama-insights-search skill.
- Provides expert-level, domain-targeted, and noise-filtered retrieval configurations for patent panorama projects.
- Exports clean candidate pools, validated branch search strategies, a lightweight core patent recall list, and a hierarchical tech taxonomy file for downstream analytics.
- Focuses solely on search quality; statistics, profiling, and core patent grading have been moved to the next stage (patent-panorama-insights-stats).
- Outputs five mandatory files: search_config.json, candidate_pool.csv, core_recall.csv, tech_taxonomy.txt, and report_manifest.json, for seamless integration with downstream tasks.
